suggested_solution: Airflow/Fan Setup: Check the case fan setup to ensure proper airflow and cooling.
Undervolting: Try undervolting the GPU to reduce temperatures.
Memory Overclocking: Reduce the memory overclocking (from +1399) to prevent overheating.
Benchmarking: Run benchmarks with a lower temperature target or adjust the thermal limit of the CPU and GPU to reduce temperatures during benchmarking.
GPU Repaste: Consider repasting the GPU, but this should be done with caution and only if necessary.
